title: 10 Million in Micron Calls After a Record Quarter Got Ignored
speaker: tastylive Signal vs. Noise host

macro_themes.view: ~75% of Micron's FY2027 output sold, HBM contracted at higher prices, tight through 2028; compute treated like national security.
Record quarters failing to lift the stock may signal washed-out expectations, as with Nvidia earlier.

calls.reason: $10.57M of bullish flow after a record quarter and guide: short-dated Oct calls/short put plus ~$7.5M in Dec 18 calls betting fundamentals overpower a muted reaction.
calls.quote: folks expect the rally to continue

notes: Date: Friday after Wednesday earnings, with Oct 2 options expiring 'today' -> 2026-10-02 (listing 10-05). Prices garbled: '10.66'/'10.83' = $1,066/$1,083. Dec strike quoted as '1,050' with breakeven '1,056-1,057, ~9% above the stock', which is inconsistent; no target recorded. Bias is the flow's and host's (host says fundamentals don't look like changing), conviction medium given his caveats.
